Definition: properly, to adjure, i.e. (usually in a bad sense) imprecate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to swear, curse; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to swear, take an oath (before God); 1a2) to curse; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to put under oath, adjure; 1b2) to put under a curse
